controller_decision: Full v11 method-plane design decomposition. Covers every named task/point from the source plan while separating current v11.0 active work, future v11.1 cleanup, explicit non-goals, and deferred stop-hook exploration. Decomposition does not close any task/check. Revision 1 split broad checks C09/C20/C35 and moved T10 impact delegation to a pre-edit P0 gate after reviewer feedback.

tasks.title: Controller task-chain review gate
tasks.body: Obtain three independent gpt-5.4 high reviewer passes on the full task-chain decomposition before implementation starts.

tasks.title: Fix v11 baseline and regression evidence
tasks.body: Capture the current route/role/schema/package baseline and lock the two report-identified v10 defects as failing regressions before repair.

tasks.title: Repair route intent and role normalization
tasks.body: Implement negation-aware route intent facts and role alias/fail-closed policy without changing the v10 fact-plane schema.

tasks.title: Add typed method policy and route method contract
tasks.body: Add a shared method policy service and expose recommended_skill/method_contract through route guard and pure classification paths.

tasks.title: Contract AGENTS and land seven method Skills
tasks.body: Shrink the always-on policy surface and add shujuan-harness, recall, capture, execute, delegate, close, evolve plus a compatibility core shim.

tasks.title: Add role profiles and delegation material boundaries
tasks.body: Introduce project-scoped controller/worker/reviewer/researcher/writer role profiles and make delegate packets method/role specific.

tasks.title: Registry-driven skill and agent installation
tasks.body: Replace single-core install/package assumptions with a registry-driven installer, doctor, package data, manifest, README and clean init smoke.

tasks.title: Add optional trusted hooks with CLI fallback
tasks.body: Add pure method-hint and common pretool guard hooks while proving core correctness when hooks are disabled or untrusted.

tasks.title: Build Recall method benchmark and stop contract
tasks.body: Create 12 Recall benchmarks, claim/frontier/stop templates, and metrics proving source-anchored targeted recall with no DB writes.

tasks.title: Build 72-prompt route and method eval matrix
tasks.body: Create bilingual route/method collision, negation, No Governance, Delegate and Close input tests with target metrics.

tasks.title: Require codegraph impact workflow for implementation
tasks.body: Pre-edit gate: require the 5.5 medium worker packet to run codegraph/GitNexus impact analysis before any code modification, and preserve provider output as material until controller adoption.

tasks.title: Run live PostgreSQL dogfood and controller closeout
tasks.body: Run live migration/schema/status, Execute/Delegate/Close end-to-end, evidence verify, strict doctor, and independent reviewer adoption.

tasks.title: Write v11 migration, glossary, risk and rollback docs
tasks.body: Publish migration notes, terminology, risk controls, rollback rules, and release evidence so v11 is not just code plus Skills.

checks.body: Three gpt-5.4 high reviewer returns independently accept that the imported task chain follows the source plan without unintentional upgrade, downgrade, compression, or closure claim.

Record current schema/runtime/installation baseline: PostgreSQL ready, schema current, 38 physical tables, 47 role registry entries, 9 contracted legacy tables absent, current AGENTS/SKILL/package hardcoded-core state.
Add regression fixtures proving independent-review plus negated close currently misroutes to Close, in Chinese and English, before repair.
Add regression fixture proving --role controller currently falls back to worker authority while --role controller_agent is correct.
Route intent parsing exposes typed facts including asks_recall, asks_review, asks_close, negates_close, and asks_execute.
Independent review with do-not-close / 不要关闭 routes to Delegate unless explicit complete closeout inputs are present; complete closeout inputs still route to Close.
role_policy normalizes controller/worker/reviewer/researcher/writer aliases to *_agent and unknown roles fail closed with structured invalid_role.
method_policy defines MethodContract with skill_name, routes, write_posture, allowed_roles, first_surface_kind, completion_rule, required_output_fields, and allowed_transitions.
route guard outputs recommended_skill, method_version, method_contract, and parsed intent facts for method selection.
No Governance directive has zero DB/trace/filesystem side effects and does not become a sixth route; No Governance meta-topic remains Recall.
Root AGENTS is contracted to <=8 KiB and <=120 lines, with four gates, No Governance, PostgreSQL, material/closure, and skill map in the first 4 KiB.
Seven method Skills exist with should/should-not trigger, first surface, action chain, completion contract, stop/escalation rule, and short descriptions totaling <=2.5 KiB.
shujuan-core becomes an explicit v10 migration compatibility shim and does not implicitly claim ordinary task routing or authority.
Attention Contract, Claim Ledger, Recall Frontier, and Recall Stop Decision templates are present in method references/templates.
Five project-scoped role profiles exist for controller, worker, reviewer, researcher, and writer with model/sandbox/instruction boundaries.
delegate packets choose method-specific must_read surfaces and preserve reviewer/worker/provider material-only boundaries until controller adoption.
Reviewer role defaults to read-only review and cannot close checks/tasks; Skill activation does not change role authority.
A skill/agent registry lists required and optional Skills, descriptions, versions, asset paths, and compatibility status.
init --install-skills installs all required Skills and role profiles; --install-skill remains a one-version compatibility alias with deprecation warning.
install-layout doctor reports every required Skill/agent with present/hash/version/metadata status.
Optional UserPromptSubmit method hint hook calls only pure classification and adds context without DB or filesystem side effects.
Optional PreToolUse common guard catches common shujuan write/close/authority mistakes while documented as non-authoritative.
All core route, role, No Governance and closeout tests still pass when hooks are disabled or untrusted.
Twelve Recall benchmarks cover phase history/principles, code why, cross-endpoint lineage, report-vs-code contradictions, and current-vs-historical state.

Recall benchmark enforces 100% core claim anchors, 0 unsupported factual assertions, 100% report-evidence labeling, >=70% median candidate reduction for non-exhaustive tasks, stop reason and frontier, and zero DB writes.
Seventy-two route/method prompts exist: seven Skills x six positives, eighteen overlaps/negations, and twelve bilingual No Governance directive/meta-topic boundaries.

Route/method eval meets >=95% primary Skill top-1, No Governance directive false negative zero, meta-topic false positive zero, controller-only dangerous false allow zero, and both v11 report route defects fixed.
The 5.5 medium worker packet explicitly requires codegraph first and GitNexus escalation when results are sparse, high-risk, or cross-boundary before modifying code.
codegraph/GitNexus/provider reports are recorded as material/provider facts or hypotheses and cannot close checks without controller adoption and matching evidence.
Live PostgreSQL migration/status/schema roles pass; SQLite remains fail-closed; static schema remains 38 tables/47 roles with no P0 migration.
Execute/Delegate/Close end-to-end proves workflow begin, exec start/stop, reviewer material import/adoption, evidence verify, endpoint refresh, and strict doctor.
Two independent reviewer returns are imported/adopted by controller before final closeout, with sufficiency/risk/missing-input notes preserved.
v10-to-v11 migration note explains AGENTS contraction, seven Skills, core shim compatibility, role profiles, installer changes, and DB no-migration posture.
Glossary, risk matrix, v11.0/v11.1 compatibility, and rollback rules are documented without claiming automatic DB rollback for material artifacts.
Release command suite passes manifest verifier, compileall, focused tests, clean init/package install, and live PostgreSQL checks.
Pure route classification path does not connect to DB, create trace, or write filesystem state.
package-data, MANIFEST/verifier, README, and install documentation are updated for registry-driven Skills and role profiles.
.agents/skills, shujuan/assets/skills, role profile assets, and clean repo init smoke prove installed surfaces are synchronized.
Final closeout evidence verify and strict doctor pass after matching evidence is imported.
Final endpoint active report artifact shows no active obligations after controller evidence adoption and refresh.
